text:
maria_support: Hey team, Acme reported the invoice shows 12.3k tokens for session id abc123 but the dashboard shows 9.8k. They were using streaming SSE and the client canceled mid-gen. Any ideas?

Dana_acme: confirming — we hit cancel at ~15:21:47Z, got a partial final chunk then connection closed. Dashboard shows 9.8k tokens. Invoice charged 12.3k. Please advise.

james_eng: Can you paste session id and approximate timestamps? Also logs from ingestion service and the SSE payloads.

maria_support: session abc123, started 2024-11-06T15:21:02Z, canceled ~2024-11-06T15:21:47Z. Snippet below:

```
SSE: data: {"token_count": 512, "chunk_idx": 7}
SSE: data: {"token_count": 128, "chunk_idx": 8, "final": true}
HTTP: client disconnect
```

charlie_sre: I'm checking the pipeline. Hypothesis: billing aggregator double-counts the 'final' chunk when client-initiated cancel triggers a retry path in ingest lambda. Seen this pattern once before. Pulling logs now.

billing_bot: Recon job -> session abc123 -> ledger: streaming.tokens=12345 ; dashboard.reported=9876

james_eng: Also check KV cache flush path — sometimes a KV flush emits an extra ledger event. Grep for `emit_ledger_event`.

charlie_sre: Found two emit_ledger_event at 2024-11-06T15:21:48Z and 2024-11-06T15:21:49Z. Second has `partial_final=true` but same seq_id. Dedupe failed because seq_id mutated by abort wrapper.

maria_support: So they were charged twice for the last partial chunk?

charlie_sre: Likely. I'll open an internal bug to make dedupe use stable session+chunk_idx keys. For now recommend issuing a credit and a short-term filter in aggregator.

maria_support: @ella_billing can you handle the credit and customer comms? ETA to patch?

ella_billing: I'll issue a pro-rata credit for the ~2469 token delta and notify Dana. Patch ETA: ~72 hours. Will coordinate with eng for the canary.

james_eng: Quick mitigation: adding a 5s suppression for duplicate emit events when `partial_final` is set. Deploying a canary to staging now.

dana_acme: Thanks, please confirm when credit posts — this hit our finance review. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

maria_support: Will follow up once credit is posted and patch is canaried. Keeping thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
